previousSlot.label: Manual docking cockpit and live instruments
previousSlot.purpose: Show the separate terminal docking exercise, cockpit camera and actual range/alignment/RCS readings.
previousSlot.captureInstructions: Enter the normal docking exercise. Use ordinary RCS controls and select Cockpit. Capture a readable approach frame with range, closing speed, lateral offset and reserve visible. Record powered-assist states. A separate soft-capture image may be retained as supporting evidence; do not quote secured post-capture zero values as approach measurements.
